queries.name: Daftar Invoice Belum Lunas
queries.purpose: Menampilkan invoice penjualan yang masih outstanding sebagai detail operasional piutang customer.
queries.query: SELECT si.sinotransaksi AS nomor_invoice, si.sitgl AS tanggal_invoice, si.sitgljatuhtempo AS tanggal_jatuh_tempo, c.knama AS nama_customer, si.simatauang AS mata_uang, si.sitotaltransaksi AS total_invoice, si.sijmlbayar AS total_terbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS outstanding, CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CURDATE() <= si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) END AS hari_telat, si.sistatuslunas AS status_lunas FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 ORDER BY outstanding DESC, si.sitgl ASC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Outstanding dan Aging per Customer
queries.purpose: Merangkum total outstanding customer sekaligus distribusi aging bucket untuk analisis collection dan outstanding.
queries.query: SELECT c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice_belum_lunas, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL OR CURDATE() <= si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_belum_jatuh_tempo, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_1_30_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_31_60_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_61_90_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 90 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS bucket_diatas_90_hari FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Customer Risiko Keterlambatan Tertinggi
queries.purpose: Memprioritaskan customer dengan risiko overdue tertinggi berdasarkan outstanding overdue, jumlah invoice overdue, dan hari keterlambatan maksimum.
queries.query: SELECT c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice_belum_lunas, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jumlah_invoice_overdue, MAX(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE 0 END) AS maksimum_hari_telat FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama HAVING overdue_outstanding > 0 ORDER BY overdue_outstanding DESC, maksimum_hari_telat DESC, jumlah_invoice_overdue DESC LIMIT 100

Untuk menghitung funnel bulanan, saya memakai tabel header tiap dokumen karena user meminta progres per tahap dokumen, bukan per item. Tahap yang diminta adalah SQ, SO, DO, DR, dan SI, sehingga saya agregasikan jumlah dokumen unik per bulan dari masing-masing tabel header. Saya menerapkan always_apply_filters yang tersedia di schema: sqisclose = 0 pada m5_sq, soisclose = 0 pada m5_so, doisclose = 0 pada m5_do, dan siisclose = 0 pada m5_si. Tabel m5_dr tidak memiliki always_apply_filters di schema sehingga tidak saya tambahkan filter default buatan sendiri. Untuk membuat funnel lintas tahap per bulan tanpa window function, saya buat subquery agregat bulanan per tabel lalu gabungkan dengan UNION atas daftar bulan yang muncul agar semua bulan yang memiliki salah satu dokumen tetap tampil. Query pertama memberi ringkasan funnel bulanan. Query kedua menghitung conversion rate antar tahap dengan pembagi berbasis jumlah dokumen tahap sebelumnya pada bulan yang sama menggunakan CASE saat pembagi nol. Query ketiga memberi tren bulanan seluruh tahap dalam format wide agar mudah divisualkan sebagai line chart multi-series. Saya menghindari join antar dokumen langsung karena untuk funnel bulanan yang diminta user, jumlah dokumen per tahap per bulan sudah representatif dan lebih aman terhadap duplikasi detail.

Konversi yang dihitung adalah konversi agregat jumlah dokumen per bulan, bukan linkage dokumen individual dari SQ ke SO/DO/DR/SI.

queries.name: Funnel Bulanan Penjualan
queries.purpose: Menampilkan jumlah dokumen per tahap funnel penjualan per bulan dari SQ ke SO, DO, DR, dan SI.
queries.query: SELECT bm.bulan AS bulan, COALESCE(sq.sq_count, 0) AS jumlah_sq, COALESCE(so.so_count, 0) AS jumlah_so, COALESCE(doct.do_count, 0) AS jumlah_do, COALESCE(dr.dr_count, 0) AS jumlah_dr, COALESCE(si.si_count, 0) AS jumlah_si FROM (SELECT bulan FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sqtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan FROM m5_sq WHERE sqisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sqtgl, '%Y-%m') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sotgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan FROM m5_so WHERE soisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sotgl, '%Y-%m') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dotgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan FROM m5_do WHERE doisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(dotgl, '%Y-%m') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(drtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan FROM m5_dr GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(drtgl, '%Y-%m') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sitgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan FROM m5_si WHERE siisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sitgl, '%Y-%m')) m) bm LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sqtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, COUNT(DISTINCT sqid) AS sq_count FROM m5_sq WHERE sqisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sqtgl, '%Y-%m')) sq ON bm.bulan = sq.bulan LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sotgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, COUNT(DISTINCT soid) AS so_count FROM m5_so WHERE soisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sotgl, '%Y-%m')) so ON bm.bulan = so.bulan LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dotgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, COUNT(DISTINCT doid) AS do_count FROM m5_do WHERE doisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(dotgl, '%Y-%m')) doct ON bm.bulan = doct.bulan LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(drtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, COUNT(DISTINCT drid) AS dr_count FROM m5_dr GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(drtgl, '%Y-%m')) dr ON bm.bulan = dr.bulan LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sitgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, COUNT(DISTINCT siid) AS si_count FROM m5_si WHERE siisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sitgl, '%Y-%m')) si ON bm.bulan = si.bulan ORDER BY bm.bulan ASC

  c.knama AS customer_name,
  si_agg.total_invoice_count,
  si_agg.total_invoice_amount,
  si_agg.total_paid_amount,
  si_agg.total_outstanding_amount,
  si_agg.unpaid_invoice_count,
  si_agg.overdue_invoice_count,
  COALESCE(ic_agg.collection_count, 0) AS collection_count,
  COALESCE(ic_agg.collection_total_amount, 0) AS collection_total_amount,
  COALESCE(pv_agg.payment_voucher_count, 0) AS payment_voucher_count,
  COALESCE(pv_agg.payment_voucher_total_amount, 0) AS payment_voucher_total_amount,
  COALESCE(sr_agg.sales_return_count, 0) AS sales_return_count,
  COALESCE(sr_agg.sales_return_total_amount, 0) AS sales_return_total_amount
FROM (
  SELECT
    si.sicustomer,
    COUNT(*) AS total_invoice_count,
    SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi) AS total_invoice_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_paid_amount,
    SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoice_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 AND si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND si.sitgljatuhtempo < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_invoice_count
  FROM m5_si si
  WHERE si.siisclose = 0
  GROUP BY si.sicustomer
  HAVING SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0
  ORDER BY total_outstanding_amount DESC
  LIMIT 1
) si_agg
INNER JOIN m1_contact c
  ON c.kid = si_agg.sicustomer
 AND c.kaktif = 1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    ic.iccustomer,
    COUNT(*) AS collection_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(ic.icjmltagih, 0)) AS collection_total_amount
  FROM m5_ic ic
  GROUP BY ic.iccustomer
) ic_agg
  ON ic_agg.iccustomer = si_agg.sicustomer
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    pv.pvcustomer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pv.pvid) AS payment_voucher_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(pv.pvbayar, 0)) AS payment_voucher_total_amount
  FROM m5_pv pv
  GROUP BY pv.pvcustomer
) pv_agg
  ON pv_agg.pvcustomer = si_agg.sicustomer
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sr.srcustomer,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_return_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.srtotaltransaksi, 0)) AS sales_return_total_amount
  FROM m5_sr sr
  GROUP BY sr.srcustomer
) sr_agg
  ON sr_agg.srcustomer = si_agg.sicustomer;

queries.query:
SELECT
  si.siid AS invoice_id,
  si.sinotransaksi AS invoice_number,
  si.sitgl AS invoice_date,
  si.sitgljatuhtempo AS due_date,
  si.sistatuslunas AS payment_status,
  si.sitotaltransaksi AS invoice_amount,
  COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) AS paid_amount,
  (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS outstanding_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo)
    ELSE 0
  END AS overdue_days
FROM m5_si si
WHERE si.siisclose = 0
  AND si.sicustomer = (
    SELECT x.sicustomer
    FROM (
      SELECT
        si2.sicustomer,
        SUM(si2.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si2.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding_amount
      FROM m5_si si2
      WHERE si2.siisclose = 0
      GROUP BY si2.sicustomer
      HAVING SUM(si2.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si2.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0
      ORDER BY total_outstanding_amount DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) x
  )
  AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY outstanding_amount DESC, si.sitgl ASC
LIMIT 100;

queries.purpose: Membandingkan total collection terhadap total invoice yang jatuh tempo dalam 90 hari terakhir dan menghitung rasionya.
queries.query:
SELECT
  due.total_due_invoice_amount,
  col.total_collection_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN due.total_due_invoice_amount = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE ROUND((col.total_collection_amount / due.total_due_invoice_amount) * 100, 2)
  END AS collection_to_due_invoice_ratio_pct
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi) AS total_due_invoice_amount
    FROM m5_si AS si
    WHERE si.siisclose = 0
      AND si.sitgljatuhtempo >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY)
      AND si.sitgljatuhtempo <= CURRENT_DATE
  ) AS due
CROSS JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      SUM(IFNULL(pvd.jmlbayar, 0)) AS total_collection_amount
    FROM m5_pv AS pv
    INNER JOIN m5_pv_detail AS pvd
      ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv
    WHERE pv.pvtgl >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY)
      AND pvd.sumber = 'SI'
  ) AS col

queries.name: Pola Retur dan Tukar Faktur per Customer
queries.purpose: Merangkum jumlah sales invoice, sales return, dan dokumen tukar faktur per customer untuk melihat customer mana yang paling banyak memiliki pola retur dan penggantian dokumen.
queries.query:
SELECT
  c.kid AS customer_id,
  c.kkode AS customer_code,
  c.knama AS customer_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid) AS sales_invoice_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sr.srid) AS sales_return_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sie_map.sieid) AS tukar_faktur_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT sr.srid) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid), 0), 4) AS return_to_invoice_ratio
FROM m1_contact c
LEFT JOIN m5_si si
  ON si.sicustomer = c.kid
 AND siisclose = 0
LEFT JOIN m5_sr sr
  ON sr.srcustomer = c.kid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    si_src.sicustomer AS customer_id,
    sd_sie.idsie AS sieid
  FROM m5_sie_detail sd_sie
  INNER JOIN m5_si si_src
    ON sd_sie.sumber = 'SI'
   AND sd_sie.idtransaksi = si_src.siid
   AND si_src.siisclose = 0
  UNION
  SELECT
    sr_src.srcustomer AS customer_id,
    sd_sie.idsie AS sieid
  FROM m5_sie_detail sd_sie
  INNER JOIN m5_sr sr_src
    ON sd_sie.sumber = 'SR'
   AND sd_sie.idtransaksi = sr_src.srid
) sie_map
  ON sie_map.customer_id = c.kid
WHERE c.kaktif = 1
GROUP BY c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid) > 0
    OR COUNT(DISTINCT sr.srid) > 0
    OR COUNT(DISTINCT sie_map.sieid) > 0
ORDER BY sales_return_count DESC, tukar_faktur_count DESC, sales_invoice_count DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: Ranking Customer Berisiko
queries.purpose: Menghasilkan ranking customer berisiko berdasarkan kombinasi outstanding, aging piutang, retur, dan collection aging.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.knama AS customer_nama, ROUND(COALESCE(si.open_invoice_count, 0), 0) AS jumlah_invoice_outstanding, ROUND(COALESCE(si.outstanding_amount, 0), 2) AS outstanding_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(si.avg_outstanding_aging_days, 0), 2) AS avg_aging_outstanding_hari, ROUND(COALESCE(si.avg_collection_days_paid, 0), 2) AS avg_collection_paid_hari, ROUND(COALESCE(sr.total_return_amount, 0), 2) AS total_return_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(ic.open_collection_count, 0), 0) AS jumlah_collection_outstanding, ROUND(COALESCE(ic.avg_open_collection_days, 0), 2) AS avg_collection_outstanding_hari, ROUND((COALESCE(si.outstanding_amount, 0) * 0.35) + (COALESCE(si.avg_outstanding_aging_days, 0) * 0.20) + (COALESCE(sr.total_return_amount, 0) * 0.20) + (COALESCE(si.avg_collection_days_paid, 0) * 0.10) + (COALESCE(ic.avg_open_collection_days, 0) * 0.15), 2) AS risk_score_proxy FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.sicustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(s.sijmlbayar, 0) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS open_invoice_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(s.sijmlbayar, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(s.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(s.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(s.sijmlbayar, 0) > 0 THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), s.sitgl) END) AS avg_outstanding_aging_days, AVG(CASE WHEN s.sistatuslunas IS NOT NULL AND s.sistatuslunas <> '' AND UPPER(s.sistatuslunas) <> 'BELUM' AND s.sitgllunas IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(s.sitgllunas, s.sitgl) END) AS avg_collection_days_paid FROM m5_si s WHERE s.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY s.sicustomer ) si ON si.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.srcustomer AS customer_id, SUM(COALESCE(r.srtotaltransaksi, 0)) AS total_return_amount FROM m5_sr r GROUP BY r.srcustomer ) sr ON sr.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.iccustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(*) AS open_collection_count, AVG(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.ictgl)) AS avg_open_collection_days FROM m5_ic i WHERE i.icstatuspv IS NULL OR i.icstatuspv = '' OR UPPER(i.icstatuspv) NOT IN ('LUNAS', 'SELESAI', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED') GROUP BY i.iccustomer ) ic ON ic.customer_id = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 AND ( COALESCE(si.outstanding_amount, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(sr.total_return_amount, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(ic.open_collection_count, 0) > 0 ) ORDER BY risk_score_proxy DESC, outstanding_amount DESC, avg_aging_outstanding_hari DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Fulfillment Macet per Customer
queries.purpose: Menyoroti customer dengan backlog fulfillment tertinggi dari sales order yang belum selesai direalisasikan.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.knama AS customer_nama, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_so_open, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.sototaltransaksi, 0)), 2) AS nilai_so_open, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), s.sotgl)), 2) AS avg_aging_so_hari, ROUND(MAX(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), s.sotgl)), 2) AS max_aging_so_hari, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sostatuspl IS NULL OR s.sostatuspl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS so_belum_pl, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sostatusdo IS NULL OR s.sostatusdo = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS so_belum_do, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sostatusdr IS NULL OR s.sostatusdr = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS so_belum_dr, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sostatussi IS NULL OR s.sostatussi = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS so_belum_si FROM m5_so s INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON s.socustomer = c.kid WHERE s.soisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (s.sostatusrealisasi IS NULL OR s.sostatusrealisasi = '' OR UPPER(s.sostatusrealisasi) NOT IN ('LUNAS', 'SELESAI', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED')) GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama ORDER BY avg_aging_so_hari DESC, nilai_so_open DESC LIMIT 100
